texts: Each Keeper carries a leather case.
The case holds a wick-trimmer, a clay flask of mire-essence, a striker, a jar of ground feathers, and a pouch of salt-bloom.

fields.sentence: Each Keeper carries a leather case.

review.notes: The explicit universal takes the distributing rule at strength 1.0 / confidence 0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion and no group, the dependent existential is the Skolem function (sk_case $x), 'carry' takes Theme as listed, and leather_case emits its genus while correctly suppressing the noun modifier.

fields.sentence: The case holds a wick-trimmer, a clay flask of mire-essence, a striker, a jar of ground feathers, and a pouch of salt-bloom.

q1_issues.issue: The five coordinated objects are hung on ONE hold event as five repeated Theme atoms (statements 6, 11, 13, 18, 22), whereas coordinated noun phrases are distributive by default — replicate the whole predication once per conjunct — and one event carrying repeated role atoms is licensed only for the collective/reciprocal case (multiple Agent atoms).

Plural "ground feathers" is encoded as a single witness with (Member sk_feather_1 feather) instead of a group witness (GroupOf … feather), and the descriptive modifier is predicated of that one witness (statement 16) rather than distributed over the members as the plural-modifier rule requires.

q2_gaps: container / measure of-phrase ("a clay flask of mire-essence", "a jar of ground feathers", "a pouch of salt-bloom") — the instruction set explicitly excludes the measure type ("a cup of water") from the genitive Possession mapping but specifies no replacement encoding for the container-contents relation, leaving the entity-attached surface-preposition (Of …) oblique as the only available fallback
review.notes: (Agent sk_hold_1 sk_case_1) is correct: the instruction set's own stative-transitive example is "the tank holds forty litres" → Agent. Whether an object-incorporating agent-nominalization compound like wick_trimmer must ALSO carry the compound-kind head genus (Inheritance wick_trimmer trimmer) is left unclear — Compound kind says the genus is always emitted, while the egg_layer worked example omits it.

issues.reason: Coordination & plurals makes coordinated noun phrases distributive by default ('replicate the whole predication once per conjunct — verbal → one event each') and licenses one event carrying repeated role atoms only for a reciprocal/aggregate predicate or a bare 'together / jointly / between them'; 'hold' is neither, so five Theme atoms on sk_hold_1 fit no licensed pattern.

Categorical statements is explicit that 'a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol' and that a descriptive modifier on a plural 'always goes through the distributive rule', so a plural 'ground feathers' either mis-types a collection as a single feather or predicates a member property of the collection — false either way.

gaps_confirmed: Container / measure of-phrase ('a clay flask of mire-essence', 'a jar of ground feathers', 'a pouch of salt-bloom'): Possessive / genitive NP explicitly excludes the measure type ('a cup of water') from the Possession mapping but names no replacement, leaving the entity-attached surface-preposition (Of …) oblique as the only fallback.
new_gaps: Two Compound-concepts bullets both match a fused object-incorporating agent-nominalization (wick_trimmer): Compound kind says the head genus (Inheritance wick_trimmer trimmer) is always emitted, while the agent-nominalization worked example (egg_layer) emits only the capability and kind-relation. Which governs is unstated, so two faithful parses can differ by one atom.

A plural inside a container of-phrase ('a jar of ground feathers') has no stated routing: the bare-plural-object rule that mints a group witness is written for a participant in the occurrence, and the bare-kind-filler alternative ('grows wheat') leaves the descriptive modifier 'ground' with nowhere to attach short of a generic claim about feathers.
adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form for the coordinated objects: five separate hold events (sk_hold_1 … sk_hold_5), each with (Agent sk_hold_N sk_case_1) and exactly one Theme, the shared subject symbol carrying over per the coordinated-NP distributive default. Compliant form for 'ground feathers': a group witness (GroupOf sk_feathers_1 feather) filling the jar's (Of sk_jar_1 sk_feathers_1) oblique, with the participial descriptive modifier distributed as (Implication (PartOf $x sk_feathers_1) (Member $x ground)) (STV 1.0 0.9) rather than predicated of one witness.
adjudication.notes: (Agent sk_hold_1 sk_case_1) is correct — a stative transitive keeps Agent, per 'the tank holds forty litres' — and the compound decompositions are right: clay/mire/salt are noun modifiers and correctly left unexposed, while the referring 'striker' correctly gets its type atom and no (can strike).
